author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Keeps chosen Streamer.bot commands and Twitch rewards usable only on the scenes you pick, with a chat-reply check for Kick, and turns everything back on when the stream ends.
changelog: 4.0.63: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.0.63, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.0.49: initial release with scene-based gates for Streamer.bot commands and Twitch rewards (hidden on the wrong scene), a Check action for Kick and other platforms, change-only updates, and everything turned back on when the stream ends.

manifest.name: Scene Gates
installationSteps: Import the Scene Gates Streamer.bot package. Keep THSV Scene Gate - Apply and THSV Scene Gate - Check triggerless, and approve Apply for Scene Gates in the wizard.
Add one gate per Streamer.bot command or Twitch reward: pick the command (or paste the Twitch reward ID) and list the scenes where it may be used, such as role:live or an exact scene name.
For Kick rewards and commands, add a Check only gate and put Set Argument gateId plus Run Action THSV Scene Gate - Check at the top of the Kick action.
Enable Scene Gates and restart StreamBridge.
uninstallationSteps: Turn Scene Gates off and restart StreamBridge before removing it, so every gated command and reward is turned back on.

healthChecks.description: Confirms gates follow scene changes, send only changes to Streamer.bot, and open again when the stream ends.
